title: [Support Ticket API - GET /api/ticket-supports] Unauthenticated GET /api/ticket-supports Returns HTTP 200 OK Exposing Submitted Support & Delete-Account Tickets
environment: Staging (STAG) · Strapi Backend API & Desktop 1440×900 · Chrome · en-US · FE=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt, BE=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA> (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/user-profile/profile-details)
steps_to_reproduce: Verify same-service Strapi access-control baseline on GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/customer-requests and GET /api/hotel-bids without Authorization -> both return HTTP 403 ForbiddenError.
Prepare an unauthenticated GET request to https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/ticket-supports with NO Authorization header.
Send GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/ticket-supports and inspect the HTTP status code and returned data[] array.
actual_result: - Unauthenticated GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/ticket-supports returns HTTP 200 OK with the full paginated Strapi ticket-supports collection (data[] containing id, documentId, email, phone, type='delete_account', title, description, createdAt).
expected_result: - Per goodNstay API Standard Fail-Closed Access Control (Confluence 524593 & QA Guide §7/§8) and sibling Strapi collection parity (/api/customer-requests, /api/hotel-bids -> 403 ForbiddenError), unauthenticated public GET /api/ticket-supports must be rejected (<CHECK_OPENAPI — HTTP 401 or 403 ForbiddenError>) so submitted user support and account-deletion tickets are never publicly readable.

evidence.console: Test Case STAG-API-006 (Permission Category) | Single-Variable Delta: Omit Authorization header on GET /api/ticket-supports.
evidence.network: GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/ticket-supports (no Authorization header) -> HTTP 200 OK (x-powered-by: Strapi) returning data[] and meta.pagination.
evidence.notes: Delete Account form in chunk 1yil-2d8cpf3l.js submits to /api/ticket-supports. Strapi Public role currently has 'find' permission enabled on api::ticket-support.ticket-support instead of restricting read access to Admin. | Security Classification: OWASP A01:2025 Broken Access Control (CWE-200, CWE-284, CWE-359) · OWASP API5:2023 BFLA & API1:2023 BOLA | OWASP Remediation: Deny by default — disable Public 'find'/'findOne' permissions on ticket-support and enforce Admin/owner RBAC (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html).

classification: Confirmed Bug — Unauthenticated Public Read Access Enabled on GET /api/ticket-supports
